TutorialDescription: Learn the basics of Beyou in a quick walkthrough.
TutorialSpotlightProfileDescription: Here you can see your personal info, daily streak, and quick status.
TutorialSpotlightShortcutsDescription: Use these shortcuts to jump to categories, habits, tasks, routines, goals, and settings.
TutorialSpotlightCategoriesDescription: Categories are your first step. Click here to create one.
TutorialSpotlightCreateCategoryDescripti: Fill this form to create your first category. Create one to continue.
TutorialSpotlightCategoryListDescription: Great! Your new category shows up in this list, ready to organize habits and tasks.
TutorialSpotlightHabitsDescription: Now let's create your first habit. Click here to continue.
TutorialSpotlightCreateHabitDescription: Fill this form and link it to a category. Create one to continue.
TutorialSpotlightHabitListDescription: Awesome! Your habit shows up here and starts tracking progress.
TutorialSpotlightRoutinesDescription: Now let's build a routine. Click here to continue.
TutorialSpotlightCreateRoutineDescriptio: Tap + to create a routine manually, or ask the AI assistant in the chat to build one for you.
TutorialSpotlightRoutineFormDescription: Pick a type — Daily Routine is a great start.
TutorialSpotlightRoutineDailyFormDescrip: Add a title and click + to build your routine section by section.
TutorialSpotlightRoutineSectionDescripti: Sections organize your routine by time. Add habits or tasks inside each section and reorder as needed.
TutorialSpotlightRoutineSectionModalDesc: Define the time and add your habits or tasks to this section.
TutorialSpotlightRoutineScheduleDescript: Schedule this routine for today so it appears on your dashboard.
TutorialSpotlightRoutineScheduleModalDes: Select today in the schedule so the routine appears on your dashboard.
TutorialSpotlightRoutineTodayDescription: Your scheduled routine appears here on the dashboard. You're ready to start tracking!
TutorialSpotlightConfigurationDescriptio: Here you can update your personal info, add widgets to the dashboard, and customize the app.
TutorialCategoriesDescription: Categories are the foundation of your productivity system. They organize habits, tasks, routines, and goals.
TutorialCategoriesTip: Think about the main areas of your life: health, work, relationships, learning, etc.
TutorialHabitsDescription: Habits are recurring actions you want to build. Link them to categories to stay organized and track consistency.
TutorialHabitsTip: Start small! It's better to track 3 habits consistently than 10 habits inconsistently.
TutorialTasksDescription: Tasks are single actions that need to be done. Perfect for to-dos, appointments, or one-time activities.
TutorialTasksTip: Tasks can also be linked to categories to keep everything organized.
TutorialRoutinesDescription: Routines combine habits and tasks into timed schedules. Create morning, work, or evening routines to structure your day.
TutorialRoutinesTip: Routines run on specific days. Set them up once and follow them daily!
TutorialGoalsDescription: Goals give direction to your habits and tasks. Track progress and stay motivated over time.
TutorialGoalsTip: Break big goals into small habits so you can win every day.
TutorialFinaleScheduled: Your routine for today is ready — check items off as you go.
TutorialFinaleExplore: Start exploring and create an awesome life!
TutorialRoutineNameDescription: Give it a clear name like "Morning".
TutorialRoutineSectionDescription: Add a section like Morning and set its time.
TutorialSpotlightScheduleDescription: Pick the days this routine should run.
TutorialSpotlightConfigDescription: Replay this tutorial any time from here.
